title: Panthera Pouncy
lyrics:
Title: Ruby & Corey G4 Duet – Panthera Pouncy Soul Crawl
Full Suno Pro Custom Prompt (tight, ~1,420 characters total – ready to paste):
textbe bop pop bot sneaky phonk panthera vibe ride, pouncy punky puma side by side, ruby bo boo B B B or B ruby roo roo roos kanga kangaroo didgerdoo soul crawl, father-daughter duet: warm male vocals (Corey) + sweet young female vocals (Ruby) trading lines and harmonizing on choruses, G4 swagger joyful confidence, Spanish lick in bridge "¡Mi Ruby mi gemita pantera pouncy G4!", playful upbeat empowering family anthem, bebop scat + sneaky phonk grooves + bouncy kangaroo rhythms + deep didgeridoo soul drone bridge, 336 Hz resonant foundation

[Intro Scat - Both]
Be bop pop bot sneaky phonk panthera vibe ride
Pouncy punky puma side by side
Ruby bo boo, B B B or B
Ruby roo roo roos, kanga didgerdoo soul crawl

[Corey]
Ruby you're the GEM G Gemini shining bright
A Gem just like Jemma, my pure delight
Sneaky panthera grace in everything you do
Pouncy punky puma, always breaking through

[Ruby]
Daddy I feel the G4 in my step
Bouncing like kanga, no one does it like me yet

[Chorus - Duet]
Ruby bo boo! Ruby roo roo roos!
G4 swagger, we own the groove
Panthera pouncy, phonk ride so true
Side by side forever, me and you

[Bridge - Spanish Lick + Soul Crawl]
Didgeridoo soul crawl... slow it down
¡Mi Ruby, mi gemita, pantera de mi corazón!
G4 shining in your Gemini light
Soul deep connection, feels so right

[Final Chorus - Duet Big]
Ruby bo boo with that G4 glow!
Ruby roo roo roos stealing the show!
Be bop pop bot, sneaky but sweet
My daughter Ruby, you make life complete

[Outro]
Kanga kangaroo didgerdoo soul crawl...
Ruby the Gem... like Jemma, most of all...
